description: Records and replays Prolog execution with the explored resolution tree and backtracking.

attributes.name: filename
attributes.description: Display filename override; defaults to the source basename or program.pl.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: Prolog goal whose resolution is recorded.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Prolog source URL; loaded without executing the program.

attributes.name: trace
attributes.description: Complete JSON recording URL; takes precedence over src and inline source without executing Prolog.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Prolog source used when src and trace are absent.

methods.name: getCode(): string
methods.description: Returns the complete versioned JSON recording as a string.

methods.name: goTo(index: number): void
methods.description: Displays a zero-based event index; -1 restores the query root.

methods.name: loadTrace(): void
methods.description: Opens the saved trace file chooser without starting the language engine.

methods.name: record(): void
methods.description: Records the current editor source in a fresh Prolog Worker.

methods.name: refresh(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Reloads the trace or source according to attribute precedence.

methods.name: saveAs(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Opens Save as for the complete recording, including its original source.

methods.name: toggleJson(): void
methods.description: Expands or collapses the trace JSON panel.

methods.name: toggleSource(): void
methods.description: Shows or hides the Prolog editor without changing the recording.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-prolog-tracer>` element records and replays Prolog execution with the explored resolution tree and backtracking.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" size="2em"} Edit source | Show or hide the program editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-import" size="2em"} Load trace | Open a saved Prolog JSON recording without executing it. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-upload" size="2em"} Save trace | Save the complete recording with a filename of your choice. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play" size="2em"} Record resolution | Record the current program and query in a fresh engine. |
| :tp-icon:{name="stop" size="2em"} Stop recording | Terminate the recording Worker. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-left-first" size="2em"} First step | Return to the query root. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-left" size="2em"} Previous step | Restore the preceding event and tree. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-right" size="2em"} Next step | Reveal the next debugger event. |
| :tp-icon:{name="chevron-right-last" size="2em"} Last step | Show the complete explored tree and solutions. |
| <!-- button --> Trace JSON | Expand or collapse the complete JSON recording. |
| Select a tree node | Return to the event that created this attempt. |
| Scroll the tree | Explore branches outside the visible area. |
| :tp-icon:{name="palette-swatch" size="2em"} Color | Change the brand color. |
| :tp-icon:{name="theme-light-dark" size="2em"} Theme | Change the theme. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen" size="2em"} Fullscreen | Enter or leave fullscreen. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Return</kbd> or <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Return</kbd> in Query | Record the current program and query. |
| <kbd>Return</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> on a tree node | Return to that attempt's creation event. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls and tree nodes. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open contextual help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus; Shift may be needed to type ?. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open the component viewer. |
